# T5 Large

Google · released 2019-10

Original T5 (Raffel et al. 2019) encoder-decoder checkpoint (multi-task pre-trained mixture), not T5 v1.1 and not the LM-adapted T5.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/google-t5/t5-large)

No reviewed benchmark results yet. This catalogue entry has no score or rank.

## How to run it

```sh
uv run --with torch --with 'transformers<5' python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('text2text-generation', model='google-t5/t5-large')('translate English to German: The house is wonderful.', max_new_tokens=40)[0]['generated_text'])"
```
